situation: Nothing in story-time has been instantiated. The root has named Highkettle, a forge-house, a winter pass, a raider camp and a presentation ground, and has bound the world to ordinary metallurgy and a compact that holds on a living smith's hidden levy. No apprentice, master, relic or theft yet exists as an entity; the midwinter clock has not been started. Live state is empty. This exposé has to lock who pays and what the last photographable image is before any plot can be aimed, because a retrieval-and-household story written front-to-back will dissolve into sequence.

craft.audience_need: Adult readers promised a completed moral choice with a felt cost, an ordinary world, and no last-page rescue need, from the first document, a spine that will not let competence save anyone and will not let confession restore the house. They do not need a map of the pass or a lore bible. They need to know that the story will end on a decision that stays decided, that the cost will sit in a body and a ledger rather than in a speech, and that they will not be told whether the decision was right. Middle reading level means the moral problem must be built from work, grain and walking-time, not from abstract duty-language.
craft.genre_convention: Low fantasy leads the reader to expect a retrieval that becomes a revelation and then a confrontation with a power. Domestic drama expects the house to be the real arena. Mystery expects the object to be readable as wrong before anyone confesses. This exposé satisfies the craft-mystery and the household arena, and deliberately refuses the genre's rescue-by-power and the quest's last-league dash. The Hold will not be faced down. Magic will not unmake the bill. The rite deadline is weather and walking, not a chase. The ending will look like work continuing.
craft.theme_and_style: Theme demands that the old reasons stay audible and the present ones stay indefensible, and that iron, grain and who walks the pass make class visible. Register is vernacular, filmable, seventy percent dialogue; the exposé must therefore commit to a story in which every state change can land in what is said or pointedly refused, and in which Hetta thinks in weights, heats and what is owed as a job, never in theme-statements. Forbidden: prophecy, destined persons, a closing thaw, omniscient dips, glossary words, a villain-faced Hold, a redemptive confession that restores the household, and any third plot. The motif of true weight versus false weight must be planted in metal, packs, tithe and debt, and paid in a last image that a camera can hold.
craft.dramatic_function: Locks the ending, names the two plots and the because-links that tie them, commissions the principal entities, and sets the moral math so later nodes aim at a known last image instead of accumulating incidents. Sets up the recovery clock and the household lie. Pays off nothing. Reverses the expected quest-promise of the logline into a debt story that uses a retrieval as its first movement. Closes the question of whether anyone will be rescued.

tension_management.how: The blank page carries no pressure. The exposé loads the midwinter clock, the unread forgery, the levy already being paid, and a last choice that cannot satisfy both the village and the man who raised her. Pressure is not spectacle; it is days of walking and a bill that cannot be transferred.

craft.why_now: Plots written without a locked ending will treat the theft as the story and the household as aftermath. The root already forbids that shape. The exposé must exist first so the recovery can be aimed at the reading of the metal, and the reading at a choice whose cost is already known. Nothing in story-time precedes this; there is no earlier slot.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: Skip the exposé and open on a plot-recovery node, discovering the ending in draft.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: A front-to-back retrieval degrades into and-then walking. The reader promise is a completed choice, which only exists if the last image is chosen before the first departure is written.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: End on a public breaking of the relic at the presentation ground.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: That reads as moral triumph plus village-tragedy, which the root forbids as both too clean and too annihilating. Moral clarity is scored at 22. The old reasons must remain costly, not vindicated by sacrifice.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: End on Bram's death discharging the levy, with or without presentation.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: Death as a key is magic-as-solution by another door, and it damn him into a tragic exit the root told us not to write. Someone pays; no one is used up to tidy the ledger.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: Have Hetta tell the steward the piece is false, or tell the village and let them vote.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: That outsources the choice the apprentice is bad at making. The story is her failure at owing, not a civic process. The Hold must stay faceless and unchallenged as a system.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: Have her stay silent even to Bram, presenting and never speaking the knowledge.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: A secret kept from him as well as from the village produces no photographable confrontation and lets the household continue as if unread. The cost must land between them in what they say and refuse to say.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: Give the Hold a named villain and a negotiation scene that could soften the compact.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: A face replaces the system. Institutional critique is the point. The steward may appear long enough to accept a weight; he may not become a man who can be moved.

made: The relic will be recovered in time for the rite, by her competence, at a cost to the household.
She will read the piece as a smith and know it is a forty-year-old forgery before anyone confesses.
Bram will speak reasons that were good then and will not defend them as if they are good now.
She will choose, before the rite, and someone will pay in body or in complicity; the village will not be told.
The last image will be the village weight set against a true work-weight, the shortfall written, the fire banked, no speech.
True weight versus false weight will run through pack, tithe, metal and debt and pay on that balance-beam.
Exactly two plots, each the because of the other. No third.
The Hold will remain an offstage compact. Raiders will remain hungry people.

psychology.entering_state: A working smith of twenty-four who has lived in Bram's forge-house since she was ten. She is already past apprenticeship in the work and still inside it in name. She pays what she thinks she owes in labour and does not keep a second ledger for people. On the morning the niche is empty she treats the theft as a job with a walking-time.

perception.sight: The empty niche above the slack-tub, darker than the stone around it. Bram's back at the cold hearth. Olla in the door with a wet hem and the look of someone who has already told the rest of the street. Unlit charcoal. Yesterday's tongs left closed.
perception.sound: Olla naming the theft and the days to midwinter. No hammer. Wind in the flue. A dog on the lane. Bram saying she can walk it, which is not quite an order and not quite a request.
perception.touch: Grit on the anvil under her palm. The unused hammer-haft colder than the room. Later, the pack-straps cutting, the weight of the recovered piece sitting wrong against her spine.
perception.smell: Old slack-water and cold ash. Not today's fire. On the pass, wet stone and unwashed wool. In the raider camp, lean broth and bad iron.
perception.taste: Yesterday's crust. Iron at the back of the teeth, which is always there. Melt-water on the pass that tastes of rock.
perception.interoception: No fear-spike at the empty niche; a work-list starting itself. Hunger she will ignore until the second day of walking. After she reads the piece, a drop in the gut as if a hammer has glanced, before she has a word for what she saw.
perception.proprioception: Standing in the helper's place to the left of the anvil, not in the master's. Shoulders already set for a pack. On the pass, the shortened stride of someone saving the knees. At the end, both hands on a balance-beam as if it were a tool and not a verdict.
perception.attention: At the open she attends to walking-time, fuel, and whether the piece will be sold or broken by people who need the metal. She fails to notice that Bram does not reach toward the niche, that his right hand stays in the apron, that the morning fire was not laid — he always lays it — and that he has decided to send her before Olla finished speaking.

appraisal.value_at_stake: Work honestly done, and the practical survival of the house that fed her. She does not yet know that a third value — what a raised person owes the raiser when the raising was also a lie — is the one that will break the first two against each other.
appraisal.moral_reading: A thing that belongs to the village was taken by hungry people. Fetching it is the forge-house's job because the forge-house keeps the iron. Midwinter is a date, not a judgement.
appraisal.somatic_marker: Shoulders settling, jaw easy, the small warmth of a problem that can be carried. No flush, no chill. The later shock will arrive as a missed heartbeat when the quench-line is wrong.

norms_in_force: The forge-house answers for the village iron.
An apprentice goes when the master says the walk is hers.
Women at the anvil are believed on metal and doubted on compact-law.
You do not speak a household shame into the lane.
You present at midwinter or you forfeit; argument is not a third option.
social_norms.how_others_would_judge: Olla and the lane will think well of her for going and worse of her if she fails. They will not think she has a right to refuse. Bram will think she is doing as trained. After the reading, anyone who saw her hesitate over the piece would think her disloyal before they thought her correct.
social_norms.how_absent_others_would_judge: The dead of Highkettle who paid iron for three generations would call the fetch ordinary duty. The Hold would not care who walks so long as a weight and a tithe arrive. The raiders would call her a thief with a better valley. The woman she will be at the end will judge the woman at the open for treating a debt as a job.
social_norms.standing_at_risk: If she fails the fetch she is the girl who lost the winter. If she succeeds and then speaks, she is the girl who broke the house. If she succeeds and is silent she keeps her name and loses the only honest standing she had with Bram.
social_norms.norm_conflict: Duty to the compact and the lane versus duty to the man who raised her and is paying the levy that makes the compact hold. At the open, duty to the lane wins by default because she has not yet seen the other duty. At the close, duty to the lane still wins, but now she knows what it costs him, and that knowledge is the new standing she will have to live in.

theory_of_mind.d1: He is sending her because she is faster on a winter pass and because fetching is apprentice work. He is tired the way old smiths are tired. The weight is a village object he has kept as he keeps tongs.
theory_of_mind.d2: He believes she is reliable, uncurious about anything that is not a job, and still his to send. He believes she thinks well of his teaching and does not keep accounts against him.
theory_of_mind.d3: He believes she believes the weight is what it has always been, and that she believes he believes the same — a shared unexamined fact, not a performance he is asking her to help him keep.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: Wrong on the tiredness, the reason she is sent, and the unexamined fact. He is levy-worn, not merely old. He sends her because he cannot walk the pass and because the piece in anyone else's hands might be broken or read. He knows the weight is his forgery and is gambling that her competence will stop at retrieval. The error costs her the chance to hear his reasons as a gift rather than as a defence after she already knows. It costs him the last years of being only her master.

theory_of_mind.d1: Olla is doing the speaker's job: naming the theft, counting the days, putting the fetch on the forge-house because that is where the iron lives.
theory_of_mind.d2: Olla believes Hetta is the pair of legs the village can spare and a smith good enough not to lose the piece on the way home. Olla does not believe Hetta has standing to question the compact.
theory_of_mind.d3: Olla believes Hetta believes the weight is genuine and that midwinter is simply a date the forge-house must meet.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: Right about Olla's civic reading, wrong about the limit of Hetta's later standing. After the rite Olla will still think the winter was saved by a clean fetch. The error will cost Olla nothing and will cost Hetta the possibility of sharing the knowledge with the one person who might have carried it as civic rather than as household shame.

urges.cravings: Warmth, a full bowl, the particular satisfaction of a job that closes when the piece is back in the niche. After the reading, the craving to have the metal be honest if she looks again.
urges.physical_needs: Sleep and calories the village cannot fully give her for a three-week walk. Dry feet. On return, the need to sit that she will not grant herself until the rite is done.
urges.psych_needs_conscious: To be sent, to fetch, to put the piece back, to be told the work was adequate. Later, to be given a reason that fits in a workshop explanation.
urges.psych_needs_unconscious: To remain the person who pays in work so she never has to decide what she owes in love or in blame. To have Bram remain only a master, which would keep the ledger simple.
urges.avoidances: Any conversation that would make the sending a favour or a sacrifice. After the reading, Bram's face until she has a practical question ready. At the end, the sentence that would either free him or forgive him.

impairments.physical: None at the open. On the pass: cold injury risk, caloric debt, bad sleep, a pack that will later sit wrong because the piece is short-weight. None of this disables her; all of it narrows patience.
impairments.magical: none. She is not bound. That is part of what she will not know how to feel about.
impairments.coercive: The compact's deadline, the village's poverty, Bram's sending, and the fact that no one else can be spared to walk. After the reading, the knowledge itself, which cannot be put down without choosing.
impairments.cognitive: She cannot think clearly about what a person owes the person who raised them, because she has always converted that question into hours at the anvil. She will mis-frame the forgery as a metal problem for as long as she can.
impairments.net_effect: She is fully capable of the walk, the theft and the reading. She is impaired in the one deliberation the story actually requires. Competence will get the piece home and will not help her choose.

deliberation.framing: At first: a fetch with a date. After the reading: which weight is true, and whether a false piece may be presented if it still fools the steward. The real problem — what she owes Bram, the lane, and the living who will eat this winter — stays under the work-frame until the night after the rite, when there is nothing left to fetch.

options_weighed.option: Present the piece, tell no one, including Bram.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: Village keeps the year. Levy continues. Household looks as it did.
options_weighed.cost: She lives alone inside the knowledge. No photographable reckoning. The lie gains a second unpaid keeper.

options_weighed.option: Present the piece and tell only Bram she has read it.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: Village keeps the year. Levy continues. He knows she chose the compact over his release.
options_weighed.cost: The old ease between them ends. She becomes keeper of the lie by choice, not by ignorance.

options_weighed.option: Break the piece at the presentation ground, or before.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: Levy discharges. Pass closes. Grain-right goes. He is free and the lane is not.
options_weighed.cost: Other people's hunger pays for a clean metal. She will have decided what the village owes without asking it.

options_weighed.option: Tell Olla or the steward that the piece is false.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: The Hold treats a challenged relic as forfeit. Knowledge spreads. Levy continues unless the piece is also broken.
options_weighed.cost: She spends a household shame into the lane and still does not free him unless she breaks the iron. The system gains a face to refuse her.

deliberation.reasoning: A short piece still weighs what it weighs. If the steward does not break it, the compact holds and Bram keeps paying a bill she can now see in his hand and his breath. Breaking it would be the true work — you do not send a known-wrong weight to a customer — but the customer here is a winter and the fault is not this year's. She does not know how to invoice a man for forty years of a kindness that became a lie. She knows how to present, and how to write a shortfall where the house can find it later. That is the work-shaped path through a problem that is not work.
deliberation.chosen_because: Presenting and telling only him keeps the lane alive, puts the knowledge where it already lives, and lets her pay the remainder in a ledger mark instead of in a speech she will not get right. It is the option that most resembles a job. That is why she takes it, and why it will not satisfy her.
deliberation.known_unknowns: Whether the steward would notice a challenge-quality fake if she gave him cause. Whether Bram would survive a discharge-by-breaking in any way that is not only bodily. Whether the scrap in the niche will ever be read by anyone who can use it. She hedges by writing the shortfall anyway, which is a smith's hedge: leave the measure where the next worker can find it.

control.felt: At the open, ordinary readiness. After the reading, anger she does not have a workshop word for, and a loyalty that sickens her because it has no clean object. At the close, the flatness of a decision already spent.
control.expressed: Craft talk. Packing lists. Questions about days and fuel. At the confrontation, questions about quench-line, bloom and the date of a stamp, not about love or betrayal. At the rite, the manners of a presenter. After, silence and the handling of a balance.
control.divergence_reason: She has no practised face for owing people, only for owing work. Showing the feeling would force a conversation she believes she will bungle and that she cannot take back in front of the lane or the steward.
control.leakage: She weighs the recovered piece twice in camp before she admits why. She asks Bram when he laid that particular stamp, which is the accusation in workshop dialect. She cannot look at his right hand. At the end she writes the shortfall larger than she needs to, as if the next reader might be a stranger.
control.inhibited_impulse: To ask him, before she leaves, why he will not go. To throw the piece into a crevasse and come home empty. To break it on his anvil in front of him. To say she is sorry, which would be the wrong sentence, or that he is, which would also be wrong.

psychology.intention: At the open, to fetch the weight and restore the job-shaped world. At the close, to keep the village's year and to make the falsehood measurable inside the house that made it.
psychology.action: Accepts the sending without the question that would have changed it. Walks the pass, takes the piece from people who are hungry, reads it as a smith, brings it home, forces Bram to speak the old reasons, presents the piece at midwinter, and that night sets it against a true work-weight and writes the difference.

trajectory.shift: From worker at rest to worker with a date. Loyalty still simple.
trajectory.trigger: Olla's report and Bram's you-can-walk-it.

state_delta.from: the weight is a village fact
state_delta.to: the weight is missing and fetchable

trajectory.shift: Competence confirmed; first doubt about why she was sent, still framed as his age.
trajectory.trigger: The physiological cost of the pass, and the raiders' ordinary hunger, which does not match the word theft as the lane used it.

state_delta.to: caloric and cold debt, still functional

trajectory.shift: The story she is in changes species. Job becomes debt. She knows before he speaks.
trajectory.trigger: Quench-line, bloom, stamp-date and short weight on a piece she is checking for travel-damage because it sat wrong in the pack.

state_delta.from: the piece is the village weight
state_delta.to: the piece is a forty-year-old forgery in her master's early hand

trajectory.shift: Anger and loyalty lose their clean objects. She does not decide out loud.
trajectory.trigger: Bram's account of the cracked original, the famine winter, the three nights, the harvest he did not confess after, and the child she was when telling became another kind of use.

state_delta.to: owes him something she cannot invoice, and is owed a truth that arrived too late to be a gift

trajectory.shift: She spends the choice. The lane is saved. She becomes the second keeper.
trajectory.trigger: The steward's hand out for the piece, and Bram behind her breathing as a man pays.

state_delta.to: presenter who knowingly offered false weight

trajectory.shift: She converts the remainder into a measure. The household continues without being restored.
trajectory.trigger: The beam tipping in the forge after the rite, with him in the doorway.

state_delta.to: spent, unforgiving, still in the house

psychology.leaving_state: Alive, competent, winter-saved with everyone else, and now the person who decided the levy would continue. She has not left him and she has not forgiven him. She will keep the forge. She will not ask him for the old talk. The scrap in the niche is the only account she trusts herself to keep.
psychology.unresolved: Whether she was right. Whether the scrap will ever be read. How they will share meals. How many winters he has left to pay. What she will do on the year he dies and the false piece, unbound, will not hold.

psychology.entering_state: A smith of about sixty who forged a false village weight at twenty and has paid its levy in breath, core-warmth and the steadiness of his right hand ever since. He raised Hetta because she needed feeding and because the forge needed a living future that was not the binding. He has never found the year in which telling became possible. On the morning the niche is empty he is already calculating whether the piece will be broken, sold, or brought home to be read.

perception.sight: The pulled-tooth dark of the niche. Hetta already standing in the helper's place as if the day were ordinary. Olla's wet hem. The unlit hearth he did not lay because the right hand would show the tremor if he dealt charcoal in front of them.
perception.sound: Olla's count of days. Hetta not asking why he will not go. His own voice making a sending out of a fact — she can walk it — which is true and is not the reason.
perception.touch: The constant interior cold the levy takes, worse when the hearth is down. Apron hide over the bad hand. Later, the returned piece in his palm, lighter than memory because he has not been allowed to weigh it against a true bar in forty years.
perception.smell: Cold ash, which he knows is his failure of the morning rite of the shop. Her travel-smell when she returns: wet wool, other people's fire.
perception.taste: Metal and old tea. He has not tasted a full hot meal as heat; the levy skims it.
perception.interoception: The levy as a small continuous theft of breath and warmth, so familiar it is his weather. A spike of nausea when Olla says stolen, not for the village but for the binding: if they break it he is free and the lane is finished; if they keep it someone may look.
perception.proprioception: Weight on the left hip, right hand hidden. Not crossing to the niche. After she knows, standing in his own doorway as if he needs permission to enter the shop.
perception.attention: The piece: who has it, whether they need the metal enough to break it, whether Hetta will do the job without doing the other job she is now good enough to do. He fails to notice that she has already begun to weigh the empty niche as she weighs a billet, and that his not-laying of the fire is itself a sentence she will be able to read on the way home.

appraisal.value_at_stake: The living of Highkettle, which he still believes he bought at a fair price forty years ago, and the girl he raised not to be bound. Those two values are already in conflict; the theft makes the conflict walk on its own legs.
appraisal.moral_reading: The piece must come home unbroken or the winter fails. She is the one who can bring it. Telling her first would make the fetch about him and might make her refuse, or look too hard, or pity him. Pity would be a worse debt than silence. This reading is already a defence.
appraisal.somatic_marker: Cold deepening under the sternum, the levy taking its cut of the fear. The bad hand tightening in the apron before he has chosen words.

norms_in_force: A master does not send a bound trouble onto an apprentice by name.
A master may send an apprentice into weather the master cannot walk.
Household shame stays in the house.
The forge-house answers for the village iron.
You do not ask the lane to thank you for a crime that fed it.
social_norms.how_others_would_judge: Olla would call the sending proper if she knew only his age. If she knew the levy she would call him either saviour or thief of forty winters, and he does not trust which. Hetta, if she knew now, would have to choose in front of Olla; he will not give her that audience.
social_norms.how_absent_others_would_judge: His dead master would have called the original forging a necessary wrong and the forty years of silence a failure of nerve. The Hold would call the piece a fraud if forced to look, and would not care about the children of that winter. The children of that winter, now middle-aged in the lane, would not want the knowledge.
social_norms.standing_at_risk: Master of the Highkettle forge; unspoken saviour; unspoken fraud. If the piece is broken he becomes a free man in a starving village. If she reads it he becomes a known liar in the only house he has. If she presents it anyway he remains what he was, but no longer privately.
social_norms.norm_conflict: Protect the lane versus do not bind the child you raised into your crime. He has spent forty years choosing the lane by not speaking. He chooses it again by sending her uninformed. After she knows, the same norm wins only if she lets it; he cannot win it for her twice.

theory_of_mind.d1: She thinks in jobs. She will fetch the piece and she will not look into it unless it is damaged. She loves the work more than she loves him, which he has counted as safety. She believes he is old in the ordinary way.
theory_of_mind.d2: She believes he thinks her reliable and still junior. She believes he does not doubt her metal-sense. She does not believe he is afraid of her.
theory_of_mind.d3: She believes he believes the weight is genuine, and that he believes she shares that belief as furniture, not as a story he is still telling.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: Wrong about how far her metal-sense will stop, and about love-versus-work being safety. She will look because the pack-weight is wrong, which is work, not curiosity. She does love him, in the uninvoiced way that will make the hearing worse. The error costs him the last chance to be the one who tells, and costs her a confrontation that can only sound like defence.

theory_of_mind.d1: Olla will put the fetch on the forge-house and will not ask why the master stays. She believes the weight is the original. She would break the house if she knew, or she would force a presentation anyway; he has never been sure which, which is why she has not been told.
theory_of_mind.d2: Olla believes he is a tired master doing the proper civic thing by sending the girl who can walk.
theory_of_mind.d3: Olla believes he believes the compact is clean and that the forge-house is merely its keeper.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: Mostly right about what Olla will do with ignorance. Wrong in the long habit of treating her possible responses as equally fatal. The error has already cost forty years of a possible civic sharing; it will cost nothing more because Hetta will also not tell her.

urges.cravings: Heat the levy will not let him keep. To hold the piece again and feel that it is still his problem alone. A year in which confession would be cheaper than silence — a year that has not come.
urges.physical_needs: Breath, core-warmth, a right hand that will finish a day's work. Sleep that the levy makes shallow.
urges.psych_needs_conscious: The piece home unbroken. Hetta uninvolved in the binding. The rite got through.
urges.psych_needs_unconscious: To be seen as having paid enough. To be forgiven without being freed, because freedom would mean the lane had paid instead. To remain her master rather than her dependent.
urges.avoidances: Her looking at his hand. The sentence I made it. Any plan that requires him to walk to the Hold and name the compact as the thing that starves them.

impairments.physical: Levy-taken breath and warmth; tremor and weakness in the forging hand, readable as age. He cannot walk the pass as she can. He can still finish light work.
impairments.medical: The levy's long tax has become a constitution: he is always slightly behind on heat and air. Not a named illness. No healer in Highkettle would call it anything but years at the fire.
impairments.magical: The hidden levy bound into the false weight at forging. Named, living, untransferable, unpausable. Discharges only on his death or on public breaking of the piece. It is the bill the story is not allowed to treat as a key.
impairments.coercive: The compact, the lane's ignorance, the theft, and later Hetta's knowledge, which can free him only by ruining the winter.
impairments.cognitive: He cannot think the original forging and the forty-year silence as two different acts with two different defences. He stacks them. That stack is why he still sounds, to himself, like a man who did one hard thing.
impairments.net_effect: He cannot go. He cannot tell cleanly. He can send her, wait, speak the stack of reasons when asked in workshop questions, and stand at the presentation paying. He cannot discharge what he bound.

deliberation.framing: The piece must come home. Telling her is a second problem that would interfere with the first. This frame is the error: the two problems are already one, and sending her uninformed is a choice inside the lie, not a postponement of it.

options_weighed.predicted_outcome: Fail on the pass, or arrive unable to take the piece, or die on the walk and discharge the levy in the snow while the piece is still in raider hands.
options_weighed.cost: The winter, and a death that helps no one.

options_weighed.option: Tell her first, then send her.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: She may still go. She may refuse. She may go looking so hard she cannot fetch without deciding.
options_weighed.cost: The fetch becomes about him. He loses control of when the knowledge arrives.

options_weighed.option: Send her untold, hope she does not read the metal.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: The piece comes home. The house stays as it was. Or she reads it, and he speaks too late.
options_weighed.cost: He knows this is a gamble against her skill. He takes it because the other costs are visible and this one still feels like weather.

options_weighed.option: Let the village send men, or let the year forfeit.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: Men may break the piece for spite or need. Forfeit starves the lane and does not free him unless the piece is also broken.
options_weighed.cost: He would have to watch a winter he still believes he can buy.

deliberation.reasoning: A man who cannot keep heat in his chest cannot keep a pass under his feet. The girl can. The piece is only iron if no one asks it a smith's question. She asks iron questions all day, but she asks them of work, not of relics. He will have the fire laid when she returns and it will look like a house. He has used this quality of looking-like-a-house for forty years. It has not failed in a way the lane could see.
deliberation.chosen_because: Sending her untold keeps the lie in one body for one more walk. Every other option spends the lie in public or spends the winter. He has never chosen public.
deliberation.known_unknowns: Whether the raiders will break it for the metal. Whether her eye is already better than his vanity allows. What she will do if she knows. He hedges by saying nothing that would teach her to look, which is also what teaches her that looking was forbidden.

control.felt: Fear of the piece being broken, fear of the piece being read, shame that those fears are equal, love of her that he will not spend as a reason to speak.
control.expressed: A master's practical sending. Later, a craftsman's account of a winter, a crack, three nights, a binding, a harvest that did not come, a child who needed feeding. He will not say forgive me and he will not say I would do it again as if that were still a defence.
control.divergence_reason: If the feeling shows as plea, she will have to save him or refuse him, and either would be a use of her. He would rather be judged as a smith than pitied as a father.
control.leakage: The unlaid fire. The hidden hand. The sentence she can walk it, which answers a question she did not ask. When she asks about the stamp-date he will look at the anvil, not at her. At the end he will stand in the doorway and not cross to the balance.
control.inhibited_impulse: To tell her before she leaves. To ask her not to look. To take the piece to the anvil himself and break it and let the winter come. To put his bad hand on the table and name the levy without the old story attached.

psychology.intention: Get the piece home unbroken without binding her into the knowledge. After she knows: be understood without being freed, which is an intention he will not admit and which her choice will grant him, bitterly.
psychology.action: Sends her. Waits, paying. Speaks the old reasons when her workshop questions leave no third way. Stands at the presentation. Watches her weigh the truth after and does not touch the beam.

interaction.what_collides: Hetta's habit of paying what she owes in work against Bram's forty-year decision to buy the lane with a lie and a levy; both against a compact that will take the winter if either of them chooses a true weight. The recovery and the household are the same collision on two clocks: every day she spends walking is a day she does not hear him, and every true thing he could say would slow or stop the walk.
interaction.power_balance: At the open Bram can send her and the lane can assign the fetch; she has competence and legs and no standing to refuse. After she reads the piece she holds the only lever that can free him, and it is a lever that starves Highkettle. He cannot take it back. The Hold can refuse a challenged relic and will not be moved by reasons. She spends her new power by not using it. That is the shift: from being sent to being the person who could have broken the year, and did not.
interaction.information_asymmetry: Bram knows the piece is false and that he pays; Hetta and the lane do not. The raiders know they have a heavy thing that might be worth food; they do not know it is a winter. After the reading she knows what he knows, and she knows he did not tell her, which is a second fact. The lane never catches up. What knowledge buys: he buys one more uninformed fetch; she buys a choice he cannot supervise; the lane buys a year it cannot price.
interaction.turning_point: Not the theft, not the taking, not the rite. The turning is Hetta checking a travelled piece because it sat wrong in the pack — false weight as mass — and seeing her master's early quench and a stamp that is forty years too young for an original. From that look the retrieval is over and the debt story can no longer be postponed. His reasons, when they come, arrive as defence.

established_facts_used.fact: A blacksmith's apprentice must retrieve a stolen village relic before the midwinter rite or the hamlet forfeits protection paid in iron for three generations.
established_facts_used.how_used: Becomes plot-recovery and the civic clock.

established_facts_used.fact: She is competent at craft and retrieval, and bad at deciding what she owes the people who raised her. She recovers the relic, reads it as a smith, finds a forgery. The forger is the master who raised her, forty years ago, for reasons good then and not defensible now. She must choose before the rite, and someone pays.
established_facts_used.how_used: Becomes the whole spine and the locked ending.

established_facts_used.fact: Magic exists only as binding: a named living person pays a concrete bodily or material cost; it never solves a plot problem without creating a worse one.
established_facts_used.how_used: The levy is breath, warmth and a hand. It cannot free anyone without starving the lane.

established_facts_used.fact: The midwinter rite is a compact with the valley Hold: present the relic and the year's iron tithe, or forfeit pass-protection and winter grain-right.
established_facts_used.how_used: Sets the deadline and the price of breaking or failing to present.

established_facts_used.fact: The Hold enforces by closing the pass and withholding grain; it does not police inner authenticity unless the object is publicly challenged or broken.
established_facts_used.how_used: Allows a known fake to hold if she presents and does not challenge. Keeps the Hold faceless.

established_facts_used.fact: A non-original presentation-relic holds only while a living smith pays a hidden levy bound at forging. The levy cannot be transferred, paused or discharged except by the bound smith's death or the relic's public breaking.
established_facts_used.how_used: Defines the choice-set. Death and breaking are the only discharges; both are rejected as the ending.

established_facts_used.fact: Ordinary metallurgy applies. The high passes are walkable at a physiological cost. The village is too poor to buy a replacement, hire fighters, or meet a punitive tithe. No prophecy or lineage-gift. Raiders are hungry people from poorer slopes.
established_facts_used.how_used: Keeps the retrieval modest and physical, the reading craft-based, the raiders un-villainous, the poverty structural.

established_facts_used.fact: Exactly two plots; someone chooses and pays; neither triumph nor tragedy; no redemptive confession without cost; no tragic annihilation; Hold offstage; screenplay, dialogue-led, state changes filmable.
established_facts_used.how_used: Locks plot count, ending temperature, medium, and the because-links between recovery and household.

established_facts_used.fact: Reader promise: a completed moral choice with a felt cost, a world that stays ordinary, and no last-page rescue. Ambiguity of resolution at 42: we will know what she chose and what it cost; we will not know if she was right.
established_facts_used.how_used: Chooses presentation-plus-private-telling over breaking, death, or public challenge.

constraints_honoured: plot_count = 2 exactly, with because-links in each direction

must_include: recovery before the rite; discovery of a forty-year forgery; forger is the raising master; old reasons audible; Hold as structural antagonist; apprentice competent and bad at owing; someone chooses and pays
must_avoid: prophecy, ancient evil, magic-as-solution, raiders as primary antagonist, cheap redemption, tragic annihilation, lectures, glossary, second POV, romance, third plot
motif of true versus false weight to be planted and paid
pursuing recovery costs the relationship (she does not hear him first); pursuing the relationship would have cost the recovery or the rite
magic is a bill already being paid
third limited past, one narrator (the apprentice) in later prose; exposé itself commissions that POV
screenplay: photographable last image, no unfilmable interiority in the scenes this exposé will require
Hold barely seen; no villain face
no closing sunset, snowfall or thaw as absolution

contradictions_checked.risk: A levy that can be transferred to her would turn magic into a succession device and a solution.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: Holding the root rule: untransferable, unpausable; death or public breaking only. She cannot take the bill even if she wants to.

contradictions_checked.risk: If the original relic could be remade as a true original, the forgery is a convenience, not a trap.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: The compact is on the original piece. A replacement that is not the original holds only with a levy. Poverty forbids buying standing another way.

contradictions_checked.risk: If she reads the piece at home with him watching, the recovery does not cost the relationship.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: She reads it on the return, because it sat wrong in the pack — the motif doing mechanical work — so she arrives already knowing.

contradictions_checked.risk: If Bram's reasons are only selfish, or only noble, the moral clarity score is violated.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: The famine winter and the children remain audible; the forty years of not telling, and the use of her uninformed competence, remain indefensible.

contradictions_checked.risk: A dialogue-led screenplay cannot carry a story whose climax is interior realisation.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: The reading is done with hands and a piece; the hearing is workshop questions; the choice is a presentation in public and a balance-beam in the shop; leakage is visible.

contradictions_checked.risk: Giving the raiders a campaign or the Hold a negotiator would add a third plot or a villain face.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: One modest taking from hungry people; one steward's unchallenging hand; no return fight, no audience with power.

contradictions_checked.risk: Naming the relic with a glossary word would violate style.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: It is the village weight, an iron presentation-weight. Tools and places keep ordinary names.

forward_commitments: Two plots only: plot-recovery (fetch the village weight before midwinter) and plot-household (the forgery, the levy, what Hetta owes Bram). Each is a because of the other: she is sent because he is bound and cannot walk and will not tell; she reads the piece because recovery puts it in her hands away from him; the rite forces the household choice onto a date; her failure at owing makes her accept the sending without the question that would have collapsed the lie before the walk.

Entities to discharge: en-hetta, en-bram, en-olla (village speaker), en-pell (a hungry raider, not a villain), the steward as a function not a face; en-weight, en-forge, en-highkettle, en-compact, en-levy.

Ending locked: she presents the false weight; tells only Bram; does not break the piece; the levy continues; that night she sets the village weight against a true work-weight, writes the shortfall, puts the scrap in the niche; he watches from the doorway; no speech; fire banked. Someone pays: he in body, she in complicity, the lane in ignorance. Neither triumph nor tragedy. We do not know if she was right.
Last image forbidden to use sunset, snowfall or thaw as absolution. Sound: the beam's tick, the fire settling.
Motif: true versus false weight in the empty niche, the pack, the tithe bars, the levy as unpaid mass, the final balance.
About eight scenes, about fourteen events, about 7000 words, spec screenplay, roughly 70 percent dialogue. No camera directions. No omniscient dips.
Old reasons to be spoken in his idiom (winter, crack, three nights, harvest, a child to feed), not as a theme statement. Her questions in quench, bloom, stamp and date.
POV in later narrative nodes: third limited past, Hetta only. Below the exposé, no direct speech in non-scene documents: reported semantics and illocutionary force only.

decision.resolution: The exposé will be the spine of False Weight aimed at a known last image. Hetta, twenty-four, Bram's raised apprentice, is sent from Highkettle to recover the village weight — an iron presentation-piece — stolen by hungry raiders in the three weeks before midwinter. Bram sends her untold because he forged the piece forty years ago in a famine winter after the original cracked, bound a levy on his own breath, warmth and right hand so the compact would hold, and cannot walk the pass. She takes the piece back as a modest theft. It sits wrong in the pack. She reads quench, bloom, stamp and short mass and knows it is his early work. She comes home already knowing; his reasons arrive as defence: good then, not defensible as forty years of silence or as the use of her. She presents the piece; the steward does not challenge; the lane keeps its year; the levy continues. That night she weighs the false against the true, writes the shortfall, banks the fire. They do not speak. Two plots only, each the because of the other. Someone pays. No one is rescued. The world stays ordinary.

risks: The choice to present may read as inaction to readers trained by quest-fantasy to expect a break or a confrontation with the Hold.
A dialogue-led screenplay may struggle to keep her thinking-in-work from turning into theme-talk once the hearing starts.
Bram's famine-winter reasons may sound, if played with too much music, like a redemption the ending then has to spend pages refusing.
The last image is quiet; if the preceding household scenes have not earned the care, the silence will look empty rather than costly.
Naming and the exact bodily form of the levy may need tightening when entities are written; the exposé should not over-specify dialogue that scenes must be free to find.
